title: Early Peanut Exposure Cut Allergy Rates To 1.9%
hook: Avoiding peanuts produced a 13.7% allergy rate.
closing: The reversal changed prevention advice, but families still need individualized medical guidance.
question: Did your family receive avoidance advice?

segments.say: Childhood peanut allergy prevalence reached 1.4% in the historical series. The earlier avoidance era did not stop the rise.
Early peanut exposure's allergy rate was 1.9%, challenging the old avoidance advice.
Diagnoses later fell to 0.45% after guidance changed. The timing supports scrutiny, not proof of cause.
